believed: A circular two-body orbit is enough to size speed and period at these altitudes.
tested: The results from code/orbit.py against the two-body relations in Vallado (2013), eq. 1-18 and 1-27.
learned: They agree to the last digit. Nothing outside the code has checked them yet: evidence.csv is still empty.
changed: First version of the folder: four computed nodes, one declared, one requirement.
cost: Nothing: it is the first version.
rests_on: Two-body point-mass gravity: drag and the Earth's oblateness move the speed and the period by far less than the tolerances the rest of the design reads them at.
breaks_if: A propagated orbit, with drag and J2, whose period differs from these by more than a second an orbit at the same altitude.
